text: AI is rapidly changing the modern workplace, primarily through automation. Many repetitive tasks, such as data entry and scheduling, are now handled by software, freeing employees to focus on more complex work. Beyond that, productivity tools like smart email assistants and meeting summarizers help people work faster and with less stress. However, the goal is not to replace humans but to encourage human-AI collaboration. For example, a designer can use AI to generate initial concepts, then refine the final artwork with human creativity. This shift also brings job changes: some roles will disappear, but new ones, such as AI trainers and ethics managers, will emerge. Ultimately, workers who learn to use AI wisely will have a significant advantage in their careers.
